label: Top 1% pre-tax income share
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = the World Inequality Database's pre-tax national income top-1% share (DINA research harmonization: fiscal microdata + household surveys + national accounts blended per the 2020/2025 guidelines), reached through OWID's chart door (165 entities, 1820-2024, the chart's own attribution naming WID.world; the direct WID API probed and refused from this environment — every extractor shape 403, the record in sources.yaml). A research-harmonization canonical by necessity: no collector prints the metric anywhere (the probe record). No witness tier — no cross-root machine door exists (the IDD's measure list enumerated live, the extrapolations door refused as same-root modeled). Authenticity first per ADR-0008: the compilation the corpus itself names, displayed as what it is.
license: Mixed, per source (see "sources"): OWID chart door = CC-BY-4.0 (OWID's chart-door terms; content: World Inequality Database, WID. world's own reuse terms apply upstream).
notes: THE TODD ARCS PRINT THEMSELVES (todd_refs: 7 citations, 5 books). La Défaite de l'Occident's own board — Russia/USA/France, the WID reading the corpus names — rides the door directly: USA 1913 = 20.43 -> 2024 = 20.73 (the full U-shape L'illusion économique and Après l'Empire read the rising half of: quintile concentration 1973-1990, top-5% 1980-2000), FRANCE 1910 = 22.73 -> 2022 = 12.1 (the European decline, the arc Où en sommes-nous ? reads through Atkinson-Piketty — whose series now live INSIDE WID, the same root this door carries), RUSSIA 1820-2017 in 46 points including the Soviet low and the 2017 = 20.0 return (the arc La Défaite reads as the post-Soviet oligarchy). Qui est Charlie ?'s "OECD reading, France, top 1% pulling away" is the 1990s-2010s French segment (12-13% band, printed). THE HONEST LIMITS: a single research compilation, no witness tier (the absence recorded above — the IDD prints no top-share, the extrapolations door refused); the provider's own pre-tax concept (income BEFORE taxes and transfers — a distributional-national-accounts construct, not a survey or tax statistic); the "next 9%" of La Défaite's own table (p90p99, the 9% under the top 1%) is NOT printed by this door — the WID percentile vocabulary lives behind the blocked API, registered as the future door; the aggregate rows (World, OWID_WRL) resolve to no registry entity and drop logged, the same discipline every OWID door applies; GDR rides as its own entity (OWID_GDR — the East German print, the communist-era low the German seam's family story already carries). The 19th-century tails (pre-1900 values) are the compilation's own historical reconstructions — the layer judgment rides the root label, displayed never hidden.
